who.title: Non-Resident Bengali — beyond geography.
who.lede: Whether you live in New York, London, Bengaluru, or even a high-rise in Kolkata, your roots lie in a native village where your parents or grandparents grew up. That deep emotional bond and longing to see your ancestral soil prosper is what unites us. This Durga Puja, transform nostalgia into tangible impact.

opportunity.title: Bengal’s agricultural resurgence.
opportunity.lede: Bengal stands at the historic threshold of an economic and agricultural renaissance. With unprecedented development initiatives and funding momentum underway, the possibility for historic transformation is here. Great possibilities only deliver when citizens actively take ownership. We cannot let this historic moment pass by. NRBs have the power, perspective, and resources to ensure this agricultural rebirth becomes a living reality.

about.title: A farmers’ movement, West Bengal chapter.
about.lede: Rooted in India’s post-independence agricultural movement since 1955, formally structured in 2007, and now reinvigorated for the 21st century. Spearheaded in West Bengal under the leadership of State President Mahacharya Sourabh J. Sarkar.
about.mandate: Mobilising technology, grassroots farmer producer networks, and modern agribusiness practices to make Bengal’s farming self-reliant, sustainable, and prosperous.

model.title: One village farm. One NRB patron.
model.lede: 5,000 village locations paired with 5,000 dedicated NRB patrons. Identified local teams of 2 to 3 progressive farmers or FPOs contribute their land, sweat equity, and working capital. The contribution ask is ₹1,00,000 per farm — staggered as ₹20,000 every two months over the year. A BKS digital portal will let patrons anywhere in the world follow planting cycles and operational milestones. As farms expand, donors may also join local FPOs as commercial equity partners.

faq.title: Farms, funds, and how patronage works.

items.a: A Farmer Producer Organisation — the local vehicle for each village farm. Identified teams of two to three progressive farmers or FPOs put in land, sweat equity and working capital. Your ₹1 lakh is the seed that sits beside that.
Seed for one integrated model farm: pond and water, bund horticulture, livestock, bio-inputs and the working cycle of the farm. Land and labour come from the local farmer team.
Yes. ₹20,000 every two months over the year, or ₹1 lakh in one contribution. Register here and Bharatiya Krishak Samaj will complete the payment with you — UPI, net banking, or international cards.
Bharatiya Krishak Samaj, West Bengal will share contribution documentation with every patron. The applicable tax pathway will be confirmed with you when your adoption is completed.

items.q: How do I follow the farm?
items.a: A BKS digital portal will carry planting cycles and operational milestones. This page will also carry daily and weekly video from the East Kolkata Wetland demo farm as those dispatches are posted.

demo.eyebrow: Durga Puja 2026 · live integrated farm pandal
demo.title: East Kolkata Wetlands — 500 metres from Sector V
demo.lede: Not just a temporary pandal, but a fully functional, live model integrated farm created over months. It sits on the boundary between urban high-tech (Sector V, Kolkata’s IT & tech capital) and the rural wetland ecosystem — showing how AI, smart agriculture and modern sustainable practice will power the future of Bengal farming. Walk through a live blueprint of what will be replicated across 5,000 villages between Durga Puja 2026 and Durga Puja 2027.
demo.statusNote: The first live IFS demo farm is being built here as the central pavilion of Krishak Samaj Puja 2026.
